caption:
SpaceX posted this when its V3 Starship was weeks away from its very first flight. Both the ship and the booster were brand new designs that had never left the ground.

Starship is already the most powerful rocket ever built. V3 was SpaceX's push to make it more reusable and more reliable, the version they believe can realistically carry people to Mars. Every generation they build gets closer to that.

By now, that flight has happened. This is what V3 looked like right before anyone knew if it would work.
